Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
10:45 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent 6-core or better processor. Those matter more than a fancy graphics card.

Memory: 16 GB minimum. 8 GB gets slow fast with a code editor, browser and Docker open.
Storage: 512 GB SSD, ideally with a free slot to add more later.
Processor: Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 (H or P series) for speed. An Apple M-series Air also fits if you find one in budget, and it has great battery life.
Screen and keyboard: full HD or better, matte if possible, and a keyboard you like typing on for hours.
Graphics card: only needed for games or AI training, so skip it to save money.

What will you mostly build: web or app development, data and AI work, or games?
